Got questions?

Everything people ask us before they sign up.

Simplify is free for job seekers — matches, autofill, and the tracker included. We make money from Simplify+ subscriptions and from employers who hire through us.

Build one profile. We match it against millions of openings, autofill applications with the Copilot extension, tailor your resume per role, and track every application in one place.

Your profile is yours. We share it with employers only when you apply or choose to make it visible, we never sell your data, and you can export or delete it at any time — see our privacy policy for the full picture.

We index postings directly from 50+ job boards and company career pages daily, then rank them against your preferences and experience.

No, but it saves the most time — Copilot fills repetitive application questions for you on any site.

You can subscribe to Simplify+ on the web or in the Simplify iOS app. Your membership works everywhere you use Simplify no matter where you bought it, so a subscription purchased in the app unlocks the same features on the web and vice versa. Subscriptions bought in the app are billed by Apple and managed in the App Store; subscriptions bought on the web are managed from your Simplify account.
